exposure: Women with a history of no surgery other than Cesarean section(s)
outcome: Prevalence and location of pelvic adhesions
cohort: Women with a history of one or more Cesarean sections performed > 12 months previously
finding: Pelvic adhesions are present in more than a third of women with a history of cesarean section, particularly in those with multiple cesarean sections or postoperative wound infection, and are associated with chronic pelvic pain.
mod_finding: This study investigated the prevalence of pelvic adhesions in women with a history of cesarean section.
